queueRecovery.bodyBusy_other: There are already {{count}} generations in progress. These leftover jobs are from a previous shutdown, not the clip decoding now. Resuming them queues them behind and reruns them from scratch.

queueRecovery.bodyIdle_other: HocusPocus saved {{count}} jobs before closing. You can resume them in the same order or discard them and start with an empty queue.
queueRecovery.duplicateWarning: Discarding these jobs does not affect the active generation or delete completed videos.
queueRecovery.rerunWarning: The clip that was running will start again from the beginning; waiting clips keep their order.

chat.welcome: Welcome to HocusPocus Director. Choose a skill to get started.
chat.autoRecommends: Auto recommends {{resolution}} on this GPU. An Advanced manual shot-length override is experimental.
chat.openWorkspaces: Open Workspaces to inspect prompts, references and the generation queue
chat.shortFilmHow: How would you like to create your short film?
chat.uploadRefsIntro: Upload reference images or artwork for your characters and dialogue audio to get started.
chat.uploadTrackIntro: Add a reference image (optional), then upload a track or generate one.
chat.storySetup: Set up your short film. Add reference images or artwork, name your characters, and set the target duration.
chat.narrativeHint: Structure scenes around a character arc with rising tension and emotional resolution
chat.preserveStyleHint: Locks the authored medium and reference artwork across start frames, keyframes and video.
chat.canonicalStylePlaceholder: e.g. 2D anime, clean cel shading, restrained linework, watercolor backgrounds
chat.canonicalStyleHint: Loaded from the Story world bible. You can edit it for this film without changing the master Story.
chat.characterStylePlaceholder: e.g. realistic people, handmade claymation, or clean 2D anime cel shading
chat.characterStyleHint: Applied to every visible person independently from the world art direction.
chat.planningScenesAndVideo: Planning scenes and writing video prompts...
chat.seamlessTitle: Each clip's end frame uses the next clip's start image for smooth transitions
chat.seamlessUnsupported: The selected video model renders independent native-duration shots
chat.autoTitle: Skip all review steps and generate automatically
chat.nameCharactersHint: Name the characters visible in the reference image so the AI can identify them.
chat.mvPromptPlaceholder: Describe your music video — subject, vibe, mood, setting…
chat.storyExamplePlaceholder: Describe the story... e.g., Two detectives argue over evidence in a dark office.
chat.shortFilmMoodPlaceholder: Describe the story setting and mood... e.g., A tense interrogation in a dimly lit room.
chat.dropDialogue: Drop dialogue audio or click to upload
chat.dropSongOrVideo: Drop a song or video or click to upload
chat.dropReference: Drop a reference image or artwork, or click to upload
chat.createsStartImages: Creates start images for each clip
chat.voiceSampleH3: Voice sample used by H3 Omni for the primary speaking character
chat.voiceSampleShort: ~5 sec voice sample for consistent voice across clips
chat.ref2vaOption: Ref2VA · character, location and media refs
chat.fl2vaHint: Only the approved generated frame is sent to H3. Character and location images above still guide frame creation, but cannot conflict with the video model.
chat.ref2vaHint: The generated shot frame plus character refs and exactly one matched location are sent. Ref2VA composes a new opening rather than preserving that frame exactly.
chat.refDurationHint: Each video/audio: 2–15 s; each category totals at most 15 s.
chat.refsPerShotHeading: References that will be sent per shot
chat.structureShortFilm: Here are the scenes based on dialogue pacing. Adjust the scene pacing if needed.
chat.structureMusic: Here's the clip structure based on the audio analysis. Adjust the cut speed if needed.
chat.moreCuts: More cuts create more start images and video generations, increasing render time and credits.
chat.guidanceCompose: Creates a composition image for each shot before H3 uses the references.
chat.guidanceNeedImage: Add at least one main, character, or location image, or choose generated shot images.
chat.guidanceDirectRefs: H3 uses your character and location references directly; no image model runs.
chat.guidanceStartFrames: Creates start frames because visual references are present or generation was requested.
chat.guidanceFromPrompt: H3 renders each scene directly from its video prompt.
chat.upscaleImage: Render then upscale the start image. Adds time per shot.
chat.turboEnables: Enables the managed LoRA at {{weight}} and uses {{steps}} steps. Adjust its strength under Video LoRAs.
chat.turboApplies: Applies to every newly generated Director shot and is saved with the project for later repair or regeneration.
chat.autoPlansAtMost: Auto plans at most {{time}} per shot for {{resolution}} on {{gb}} GB.
chat.autoDerivesLimit: Auto derives the one-pass limit from the selected canvas and GPU.
chat.manualOverrideVram: Manual override exceeds Auto's {{time}} recommendation and may run out of VRAM.
chat.manualShotLimit: Manual native-shot limit. Director will plan dialogue and action to this duration.
chat.upscaleVideo: Render then upscale the video. Adds time per shot.
chat.selfRefinerHint: Re-passes the rendered video through the refiner. May improve detail or introduce artifacts.
chat.imageApiReady: External Image-01 API ready · no local VRAM or image LoRAs.
